messages:
maria: Quick sanity check — planning a short soak tomorrow in apac (hk1). Need to burst to 8x A100 for ~3 hours (start low, ramp if stable). Current reserved quota shows 4. Can vendor confirm whether we can get a transient burst to 8 and what the preemptible risk looks like? If not, what's ETA for a quota increase (we can open a formal request).

vendor-bot: Automated: Your current apac-hk1 quota: 4/12 A100 reserved. Opening vendor ticket VEND-7192 to evaluate burst availability. Will update when vendor oncall responds.

kevin: @maria can you share the model + typical seq len and expected per-GPU throughput? that changes packing/slot estimates.

maria: model: redwood/fastgen-3b, max seq 2048, typical ~1k. Expect ~15 requests/sec per GPU during steady part of the soak (mostly streaming).

raj: For the soak I recommend starting at 50% traffic so KV caches warm and we can measure p50/p95. Also add the quantization flag we discussed (fp16->int8) to reduce memory pressure: ``--quantize int8``.

sophie: pinging vendor contact now to speed this up — @vendor-bot can you escalate to apac oncall? :pray:

vendor-bot: Escalation sent. Assigned to vendor-oncall-apac. ETA for human reply ~4h. Note: if vendor only has preemptible capacity, risk of eviction is moderate during peak windows. Reserved (non-preemptible) capacity recommended for guaranteed run.

kevin: If vendor can't guarantee non-preemptible, we can run a split plan: route ~60% to apac burst and 40% to eu-west as fallback via smart-routing. More ops overhead but reduces risk.

maria: Plan proposal: start UTC 03:00 at 50% load for 1h (soak), if p50/p95 within target then ramp to 100% for 2h. If vendor can't provide non-preemptible, fallback to split-route (apac+eu). I'll open internal ticket INFRA-3221 and link VEND-7192.

raj: I'll prepare a canary config and an eval prompt set (short perf + quality checks).

hiroshi (vendor): Hi all — apac oncall here. We can provide 8 non-preemptible A100 for the requested 03:00–06:00 UTC window, please confirm the exact commit time and we will reserve. Also note bandwidth between zones may affect cross-region split.

maria: Confirming — reserve 8 non-preemptible A100 for 03:00–06:00 UTC. Thanks @hiroshi. I'll post INFRA-3221 with details and a small runbook.

kevin: I'll be on-call for the soak. tagging the release channel once INFRA-3221 is up.

sophie: Added vendor contact to the ticket and included the fallback routing plan. :thumbsup:

maria: Great — closing the loop here. Will post the ticket links and the canary config shortly.
